label: Blurb (RPI Print)
terms_note: api_by_approval for Custom API; Self-Service API self-serve ("free sandbox environment")

discovery.auth: HTTP Basic (API Key + Shared Secret from the Print API Dashboard › API Credentials)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (RPI Print API (Blurb Self-Service)) Confidence: **high** — official developer docume
auth: 1. Create an RPI Print API account (free)
2. Dashboard › API Credentials → API Key + Shared Secret
3. Send HTTP Basic (key as username, secret as password)

endpoints.notes: currency, shippingClassification, webhookUrl, payload (≤512 chars), destination{…}, orderItems[{sku, quantity, retailPrice, itemDescription, product{coverUrl, gutsUrl}}]

endpoints.purpose: status, cancel while in Holding Bin

reference.limits: 50 orders created per 24 h (excess queued up to 350, then rejected); reprints exempt. - Self-service tier ships US only - Press-ready PDFs (preflighting documented) - Terms and conditions page on the docs site

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: RPI Print (Blurb Self-Service) API Key from the Print API Dashboard > API Credentials; the HTTP Basic username.

fields.name: shared_secret
fields.help: RPI Print Shared Secret from the same dashboard page; the HTTP Basic password.

me.note: RPI has no account endpoint; the probe lists the client's orders (GET /orders?limit=10, the documented minimum) -> {totalCount, offset, limit, nextOffset, orders[]}. The OpenAPI file behind the reference page is https://docs.api.rpiprint.com/OAS3/public-api-OAS3.yaml.

create_order.note: POST /orders/create queues a real print order (201 -> {customerOrderId, statusCode, statusDescription}); it is charged once validated (orders wait in the Holding Bin and can be cancelled with DELETE /orders/{customerOrderId}, not mapped). `currency` is always USD (the only documented value). `shipping_address` is RPI's destination {name, address1, address2, city, postal, country (ISO-2), regionCode or state, phone, email}; `items` are orderItems [{sku, quantity, retailPrice, itemDescription, product{coverUrl, gutsUrl}}] with press-ready PDFs; `shipping_option` is the required shippingClassification (standard, expedited, rush, express, priority, economy). Self-service tier: US destinations, 50 orders per 24 h.

get_order.note: GET /orders/{customerOrderId}: {order{customerOrderId, status, shippingClassification, destination, orderItems}, pricing{orderTotal, itemsTotal, taxesTotal, shippingTotal, currency}, shipmentTracking[{trackingNumber, shipMethod, shipDate}], selectedShipping, validations[], paymentInfo{paymentStatus}}; status is QUEUED, RECEIVED, VALIDATING, VALID_HOLDING_BIN, PRINTING, SHIPPED, CANCELLED, ...

not_offered.list_products: No catalogue endpoint: products are SKUs documented on the Product specifications pages (https://docs.api.rpiprint.com/products-main), not served by the API.
not_offered.get_product: No product endpoint (see list_products); POST /pricing/production prices a SKU + page count + quantity but needs an orderItems array.
not_offered.quote_shipping: POST /orders/shipping/estimate takes the create-order body (destination{...} + orderItems[{sku, quantity, product}]); the vocabulary's product_id/country/quantity cannot be shaped into that body by the runtime's flat body form.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; shipmentTracking[{trackingNumber, shipMethod, shipDate, estimatedArrival}] are part of GET /orders/{customerOrderId} (see get_order).

evidence: probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://docs.api.rpiprint.com/OAS3/public-api-OAS3.yaml: 3/3 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
